summary_ja: SA-CCRによる与信相当額（1.4×(RC＋PFE)）の算出方法を定める。再構築コスト（マージン・アグリーメントの有無別）、ボラティリティ調整率、リスクのマージン期間、PFE（multiplier×アドオン合計）、資産クラス（金利・為替・信用・株式・コモディティ）別のヘッジセット、アドオン、実効想定元本、デルタ調整値、マージン期間調整値を規定する。
summary_en: SA-CCR: exposure = 1.4 × (RC + PFE). Sets out replacement cost with and without margin agreements, haircuts, the margin period of risk, PFE = multiplier × aggregate add-on, and the hedging sets, add-ons, effective notionals, supervisory deltas and maturity factors for the interest rate, FX, credit, equity and commodity asset classes.
paragraphs: Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach uses SA-CCR, it shall calculate the credit equivalent amount for each netting set by the following formula; provided, however, that where multiple margin agreements (meaning agreements under which, when the amount of exposure to a counterparty exceeds a specified amount, the provision of collateral may be requested from that counterparty; the same applies hereinafter) have been concluded in a netting set (limited to a set of transactions under a legally effective bilateral netting contract), the credit equivalent amount shall be calculated for each set of transactions under each such margin agreement. Credit equivalent amount = 1.4 × (RC + PFE) RC is the replacement cost (the same applies hereinafter in this Article). PFE is the potential future exposure amount (the same applies hereinafter in this Article).

The RC in the preceding paragraph shall be calculated using the formula specified in each of the following items according to the case listed in that item. (i) Where no margin agreement has been concluded: RC = max{V − C, 0} C = C_{collect} × (1 − Hc_{collect} − Hfx_{collect}) − C_{post} × (1 + Hc_{post} + Hfx_{post}) V is the sum of the market values of the transactions included in the netting set (the same applies in the following item and in paragraph (6)). C is the net collateral amount after haircut adjustment (the same applies in the following item and in paragraph (6)). C_{collect} is the amount of eligible financial collateral received from the counterparty. Hc_{collect} is the haircut (meaning a value for adjusting the amount of collateral to take into account the risk of changes in the price of the collateral; the same applies hereinafter in this Article) applied when receiving eligible financial collateral. Hfx_{collect} is the haircut applied when receiving eligible financial collateral where the currency of the exposure and that of the eligible financial collateral differ. C_{post} is the amount of collateral posted to the counterparty (excluding collateral that is segregated by a third party other than the counterparty and for which the measures necessary to prevent a loss on that collateral in bankruptcy proceedings relating to the counterparty or similar foreign proceedings have been taken). Hc_{post} is the haircut applied, when posting collateral, according to the type of assets delivered to the counterparty. Hfx_{post} is the haircut applied when posting collateral where the currency of the exposure and that of the collateral differ. (ii) Where a margin agreement has been concluded: RC = max{V − C, TH + MTA − NICA, 0} TH is the threshold (meaning the amount set in advance below which variation margin need not be collected from the counterparty). MTA is the minimum transfer amount (meaning the amount set in advance as the minimum unit of variation margin collected from the counterparty). NICA is the same as C provided in the preceding item; provided, however, that variation margin is excluded.

The haircut (H) in the preceding paragraph shall be calculated using the formula specified in each of the following items according to the case listed in that item. (i) Where no margin agreement has been concluded: {{F:p98i0}}{{F:p98i1}} H_{10} is the standard supervisory haircut provided in Section 6, Subsection 3, Division 2 (the same applies in the following item). N_{R} is the longest number of business days among the residual maturities of the transactions included in the netting set (where the underlying of a transaction is a derivative transaction and that underlying is to be delivered, meaning the number of business days between the maturity date of the underlying derivative transaction and the calculation reference date); provided, however, that where it is less than ten business days, it shall be ten business days. T_{M} is the minimum holding period specified in Article 76, paragraph (2), item (i). (ii) Where a margin agreement has been concluded: {{F:p98i2}} MPOR is the margin period of risk provided in the following paragraph (meaning the period from the time collateral was last received from the counterparty under the margin agreement until the time the hedge of the market risk on transactions with that counterparty arising from its default is completed; the same applies hereinafter).

The margin period of risk in item (ii) of the preceding paragraph shall be the number of business days specified in each of the following items according to the category of netting set listed in that item. (i) Netting sets containing illiquid collateral or derivative transactions that are difficult to replace: 20 business days. (ii) Netting sets for which the amount of variation margin is adjusted by daily mark-to-market, and the number of transactions exceeded 5,000 at any point during the Ultimate Designated Parent Company quarter immediately preceding the Ultimate Designated Parent Company quarter (meaning an Ultimate Designated Parent Company quarter as provided in Article 57-17, paragraph (2) of the Act; the same applies hereinafter) to which the calculation reference date belongs: 20 business days. (iii) Netting sets for which the amount of variation margin is adjusted by daily mark-to-market, arising vis-à-vis indirect clearing participants from carrying out, as a direct clearing participant, securities clearing brokerage provided in Article 2, paragraph (27) of the Act relating to indirect clearing participants' transactions with qualifying central counterparties, commodity clearing transactions provided in Article 2, paragraph (20) of the Commodity Derivatives Act relating to indirect clearing participants' transactions with qualifying central counterparties, or other brokerage relating to indirect clearing participants' transactions with qualifying central counterparties or similar overseas transactions: 5 business days. (iv) Netting sets for which the amount of variation margin is adjusted by daily mark-to-market (excluding those falling under the preceding three items): 10 business days. (v) Netting sets for which the amount of variation margin is adjusted by mark-to-market every N days (N being an integer of two or more): F + N − 1 F is the margin period of risk determined under the provisions of the preceding four items.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the preceding paragraph, where, during the two most recent consecutive Ultimate Designated Parent Company quarters before the Ultimate Designated Parent Company quarter that includes the calculation reference date, there have been three or more instances in which, for a netting set, a close-out period exceeding the margin period of risk specified in the items of the preceding paragraph was required because of disputes over margin calls (meaning arrangements for adjusting, through the amount of collateral, changes in the amount of credit extended due to changes in the prices of the exposure and the collateral; the same applies hereinafter), the margin period of risk for that netting set during the next two consecutive Ultimate Designated Parent Company quarters shall be a period at least twice the margin period of risk specified in the items of the preceding paragraph.

The PFE in paragraph (1) shall be calculated using the following formulas. PFE = multiplier × AddOn^{aggregate}{{F:p99i0}} AddOn^{aggregate} = AddOn^{(IR)} + AddOn^{(FX)} + AddOn^{(Credit)} + AddOn^{(Equity)} + AddOn^{(Com)} AddOn^{(IR)} is the add-on for interest rate derivatives. AddOn^{(FX)} is the add-on for foreign exchange derivatives. AddOn^{(Credit)} is the add-on for credit derivatives. AddOn^{(Equity)} is the add-on for equity derivatives. AddOn^{(Com)} is the add-on for commodity derivatives.

In calculating the PFE in paragraph (1) under the provisions of the preceding paragraph, the transactions included in a netting set shall be allocated to the transactions specified in each of the following items according to their risk driver (meaning the main factor affecting the market value of the transaction; the same applies hereinafter in this paragraph) listed in that item; provided, however, that where a transaction has multiple risk drivers, it may be allocated simultaneously to multiple transactions specified in those items. (i) Changes in interest rates, etc.: interest rate derivatives. (ii) Changes in foreign exchange, etc.: foreign exchange derivatives. (iii) Changes in the credit standing of the underlying obligor: credit derivatives. (iv) Changes in share prices, etc.: equity derivatives. (v) Changes in commodity prices, etc. and changes in risk drivers other than those listed in the preceding four items: commodity derivatives.

Transactions allocated to the transactions specified in the items of the preceding paragraph shall be allocated to the hedging sets specified in each of the following items according to the category of transaction listed in that item. (i) Interest rate derivatives: hedging sets established for each set of interest rate derivatives referencing interest rates in the same currency. (ii) Foreign exchange derivatives: hedging sets established for each set of foreign exchange derivatives referencing the exchange rate between the same pair of currencies. (iii) Credit derivatives: a single hedging set. (iv) Equity derivatives: a single hedging set. (v) Commodity derivatives: hedging sets established for each set of commodity derivatives referencing energy, metals, agricultural products or other commodities, etc.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the preceding paragraph, transactions referencing a basis (meaning the difference between different risk factors (meaning factors affecting the market value of the transaction; the same applies hereinafter in this paragraph and in Article 51) in the same currency) shall be allocated to hedging sets established for each category of transaction listed in the preceding paragraph and for each identical combination of risk factors.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the preceding two paragraphs, transactions referencing volatility shall be allocated, for each category of transaction listed in the items of paragraph (8), to hedging sets established separately from the hedging sets specified in those items.

AddOn^{(IR)} in the formula of paragraph (6) shall be calculated as follows. (i) The formula used in the calculation shall be as follows. {{F:p101i0}}{{F:p101i1}} is the sum of the add-ons for the hedging sets of interest rate derivatives denominated in currency j. (ii) {{F:p101i2}} in the formula of the preceding item shall be the sum of the amounts obtained by multiplying the effective notional amount of each hedging set by the supervisory factor specified in the lower column of the following table according to the category of hedging set listed in its upper column. {{T:p101t0}} (iii) In calculating the effective notional amount of the hedging set provided in the preceding item, either of the formulas in (a) or (b) below shall be used. (a) {{F:p101i3}}{{F:p101i4}} is the sum of the effective notional amounts of interest rate derivatives denominated in currency j whose E_{i} (meaning E_{i} as provided in item (v); the same applies hereinafter in this item) is less than one year (the same applies in (b)). {{F:p101i5}} is the sum of the effective notional amounts of interest rate derivatives denominated in currency j whose E_{i} is one year or more and five years or less (the same applies in (b)). {{F:p101i6}} is the sum of the effective notional amounts of interest rate derivatives denominated in currency j whose E_{i} exceeds five years (the same applies in (b)). (b) {{F:p101i7}} (iv) The effective notional amount of an interest rate derivative in the formula of the preceding item shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the duration-adjusted notional amount of that interest rate derivative by the delta adjustment value and the margin period adjustment value. (v) The duration-adjusted notional amount in the preceding item shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the notional amount of the interest rate derivative by the duration adjustment value obtained by the following formula; provided, however, that where that duration adjustment value is less than the annualized value of ten business days, the duration adjustment value shall be the annualized value of ten business days. {{F:p101i8}} S_{i} is the number of business days, expressed in years, between the earliest date of the calculation period of the interest rate contract referenced by interest rate derivative i in that item and the calculation reference date; where the underlying of the interest rate derivative is an interest rate derivative or a debt instrument, it means the number of business days, expressed in years, between the start date of the calculation period of the interest rate, etc. referenced by the underlying interest rate derivative or of the interest rate, etc. of the debt instrument and the calculation reference date; provided, however, that where the start date of the calculation period of that interest rate, etc. or of the interest rate, etc. of the debt instrument has already passed, it shall be zero. E_{i} is the number of business days, expressed in years, between the latest date of the calculation period of the interest rate contract referenced by interest rate derivative i in that item and the calculation reference date; where the underlying of the interest rate derivative is an interest rate derivative or a debt instrument, it means the number of business days, expressed in years, between the end date of the calculation period of the interest rate, etc. referenced by the underlying interest rate derivative or of the interest rate, etc. of the debt instrument and the calculation reference date. (vi) The delta adjustment value in item (iv) shall be the value specified in (a) through (c) below according to the category of transaction listed in (a) through (c). (a) Options: the value calculated using the formula specified in the lower column of the following table according to the category of transaction listed in its upper column. {{T:p102t0}} (Note 1) P_{i} is the level of the interest rate, etc. referenced by option i. (Note 2) K_{i} is the strike price of option i. (Note 3) σ_{i} is 0.5. (Note 4) T_{i} is the number of business days, expressed in years, between the latest exercise date of option i and the present. (Note 5) Φ(x) is the cumulative distribution function of the standard normal distribution. (Note 6) In this table, a "call option" means an option whose market value rises when the interest rate, etc. it references rises. (Note 7) In this table, a "put option" means an option whose market value falls when the interest rate, etc. it references rises. (b) Interest rate derivatives not falling under the transactions listed in (a) whose market value rises when the interest rate, etc. they reference rises: 1. (c) Interest rate derivatives not falling under the transactions listed in (a) whose market value falls when the interest rate, etc. they reference rises: minus 1. (vii) The margin period adjustment value in item (iv) shall be calculated using the formula specified in (a) or (b) below according to the case listed in (a) or (b). (a) Where no margin agreement has been concluded: {{F:p103i0}} M_{i} is the residual maturity of interest rate derivative i; where the underlying of the interest rate derivative is an interest rate derivative and that underlying is to be delivered, it means the number of business days between the maturity date of the underlying interest rate derivative and the calculation reference date (ten business days where it is less than ten business days). (b) Where a margin agreement has been concluded: {{F:p103i1}} MPOR_{i} is the margin period of risk of the netting set that includes interest rate derivative i. (viii) The provisions of paragraph (4) shall apply mutatis mutandis to the calculation of the margin period of risk in (b) of the preceding item. In this case, the term "item (ii) of the preceding paragraph" shall be read as "paragraph (11), item (vii)(b)". (ix) The provisions of paragraph (5) shall apply mutatis mutandis to the calculation of the margin period of risk in item (vii)(b) where there is a dispute over margin calls. In this case, the term "the preceding paragraph" shall be read as "the preceding paragraph as applied mutatis mutandis with the necessary replacement of terms under paragraph (11), item (viii)", and the term "the items of the preceding paragraph" shall be read as "the items of the preceding paragraph as applied mutatis mutandis with the necessary replacement of terms under paragraph (11), item (viii)".

AddOn^{(FX)} in the formula of paragraph (6) shall be calculated as follows. (i) The formula used in the calculation shall be as follows. {{F:p103i2}}{{F:p103i3}} is the add-on for hedging set j. (ii) {{F:p103i4}} in the formula of the preceding item shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the absolute value of the effective notional amount of the hedging set by the supervisory factor specified in the lower column of the following table according to the category of hedging set listed in its upper column. {{T:p103t0}} (iii) The effective notional amount of the hedging set provided in the preceding item shall be the sum, for each foreign exchange derivative included in the hedging set, of the amounts obtained by multiplying the notional amount of that foreign exchange derivative by the delta adjustment value and the margin period adjustment value. (iv) The delta adjustment value in the preceding item shall be the value specified in (a) through (c) below according to the category of transaction listed in (a) through (c); provided, however, that where a netting set includes multiple foreign exchange derivatives referencing the exchange rate between the same pair of currencies, the direction of the exchange rate shall be aligned so as to represent rises and falls of the exchange rate between that pair of currencies. (a) Options: for the calculation of the value, the provisions of item (vi) of the preceding paragraph (limited to the part relating to (a)) shall apply mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "the delta adjustment value in item (iv)" shall be read as "the delta adjustment value in item (iii) of the following paragraph (limited to that relating to the category of transaction listed in item (iv)(a) of that paragraph)", the term "(a) through (c)" shall be read as "(a)", the term "interest rate, etc." shall be read as "exchange rate, etc.", and the term "σ_{i} is 0.5" shall be read as "σ_{i} is 0.15". (b) Of transactions other than those listed in (a), those whose market value rises when the exchange rate, etc. referenced by the foreign exchange derivative rises: 1. (c) Of transactions other than those listed in (a), those whose market value falls when the exchange rate, etc. referenced by the foreign exchange derivative rises: minus 1. (v) The provisions of items (vii) through (ix) of the preceding paragraph shall apply mutatis mutandis to the calculation of the margin period adjustment value in item (iii). In this case, the term "item (iv)" in item (vii) of that paragraph shall be read as "item (iii) of the following paragraph", the term "interest rate derivative" shall be read as "foreign exchange derivative", the term "paragraph (11), item (vii)(b)" in item (viii) of that paragraph shall be read as "paragraph (11), item (vii)(b) as applied mutatis mutandis with the necessary replacement of terms under paragraph (12), item (v)", and in item (ix) of that paragraph, the term "the preceding paragraph as applied mutatis mutandis with the necessary replacement of terms under paragraph (11), item (viii)" shall be read as "the preceding paragraph as applied mutatis mutandis with the necessary replacement of terms under paragraph (11), item (viii) as applied mutatis mutandis with the necessary replacement of terms under paragraph (12), item (v)", and the term "the items of the preceding paragraph as applied mutatis mutandis with the necessary replacement of terms under paragraph (11), item (viii)" shall be read as "the items of the preceding paragraph as applied mutatis mutandis with the necessary replacement of terms under paragraph (11), item (viii) as applied mutatis mutandis with the necessary replacement of terms under paragraph (12), item (v)".

AddOn^{(Credit)} in the formula of paragraph (6) shall be calculated as follows. (i) The formula used in the calculation shall be as follows. {{F:p104i0}} AddOn(Entity_{k}) is the sum of the add-ons for credit derivatives referencing Entity_{k}. Entity_{k} is the corporate, etc. referenced by the credit derivative; provided, however, that where the credit derivative is an index credit default swap, it is that index. {{F:p104i1}} is the correlation coefficient for Entity_{k}. (ii) AddOn(Entity_{k}) in the formula of the preceding item shall be the sum of the amounts obtained by multiplying the effective notional amount of each credit derivative by the supervisory factor specified in (a) or (b) below according to the category of credit derivative listed in (a) or (b). (a) Credit derivatives referencing a corporate, etc.: the supervisory factor specified in the lower column of the following table according to the credit risk category corresponding to the rating of the corporate, etc. assigned by an eligible credit rating agency, listed in the upper column of that table. {{T:p104t0}} (Note) The table of Article 22, paragraph (1), item (i) shall also apply mutatis mutandis to the credit risk categories of entities other than those listed in paragraph (1) of that Article. (b) Credit derivatives referencing an index: the supervisory factor specified in the lower column of the following table according to the credit risk category corresponding to the rating assigned by an eligible credit rating agency, listed in the upper column of that table. {{T:p105t1}} (iii) {{F:p105i0}} in the formula of item (i) shall be the value specified in (a) or (b) below according to the category of credit derivative listed in (a) or (b). (a) Credit derivatives referencing a corporate, etc.: 0.5. (b) Credit derivatives referencing an index: 0.8. (iv) The effective notional amount of a credit derivative in item (ii) shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the duration-adjusted notional amount of that credit derivative by the delta adjustment value and the margin period adjustment value. (v) The provisions of paragraph (11), item (v) shall apply mutatis mutandis to the calculation of the duration-adjusted notional amount in the preceding item. In this case, the term "the preceding item" shall be read as "paragraph (13), item (iv)", the term "of the interest rate derivative" shall be read as "of the credit derivative", the term "interest rate derivative i" shall be read as "credit derivative i", the term "interest rate contract" shall be read as "contract relating to the underlying obligor", the term "interest rate derivative or a debt instrument" shall be read as "credit derivative", the term "the underlying interest rate derivative" shall be read as "the underlying credit derivative", and the term "interest rate, etc. or of the interest rate, etc. of the debt instrument" shall be read as "contract relating to the underlying obligor". (vi) The delta adjustment value in item (iv) shall be the value specified in (a) through (d) below according to the category of transaction listed in (a) through (d). (a) Options: for the calculation of the value, the provisions of paragraph (11), item (vi) (limited to the part relating to (a)) shall apply mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "the delta adjustment value in item (iv)" shall be read as "the delta adjustment value in paragraph (13), item (iv) (limited to that relating to the category of transaction listed in item (vi)(a) of that paragraph)", the term "(a) through (c)" shall be read as "(a)", the term "interest rate, etc." shall be read as "credit standing of the corporate, etc. or index referenced by the credit derivative", and the term "σ_{i} is 0.5" shall be read as "σ_{i} is 1.0 where the credit derivative references a corporate, etc., and 0.8 where it references an index", and the term "rises" shall be read as "deteriorates". (b) Synthetic securitization transactions: for each tranche of the synthetic securitization transaction, the value calculated using the formula specified in the lower column of the following table according to the category of transaction listed in its upper column. {{T:p106t0}} (Note 1) A_{i} is the value obtained by dividing the sum of the amounts of all tranches subordinated to that tranche by the amount of the underlying assets of the synthetic securitization transaction. (Note 2) D_{i} is the value obtained by dividing the sum of the amounts of that tranche and all tranches subordinated to it by the amount of the underlying assets of the synthetic securitization transaction. (c) Of credit derivatives not falling under the transactions listed in (a) and (b), those whose market value rises when the credit standing of the corporate, etc. or index they reference deteriorates: 1. (d) Of credit derivatives not falling under the transactions listed in (a) and (b), those whose market value falls when the credit standing of the corporate, etc. or index they reference deteriorates: minus 1. (vii) The provisions of paragraph (11), items (vii) through (ix) shall apply mutatis mutandis to the calculation of the margin period adjustment value in item (iv). In this case, the term "item (iv)" in item (vii) of that paragraph shall be read as "paragraph (13), item (iv)", the term "interest rate derivative" shall be read as "credit derivative", the term "paragraph (11), item (vii)(b)" in item (viii) of that paragraph shall be read as "paragraph (11), item (vii)(b) as applied mutatis mutandis with the necessary replacement of terms under paragraph (13), item (vii)", and in item (ix) of that paragraph, the term "the preceding paragraph as applied mutatis mutandis with the necessary replacement of terms under paragraph (11), item (viii)" shall be read as "the preceding paragraph as applied mutatis mutandis with the necessary replacement of terms under paragraph (11), item (viii) as applied mutatis mutandis with the necessary replacement of terms under paragraph (13), item (vii)", and the term "the items of the preceding paragraph as applied mutatis mutandis with the necessary replacement of terms under paragraph (11), item (viii)" shall be read as "the items of the preceding paragraph as applied mutatis mutandis with the necessary replacement of terms under paragraph (11), item (viii) as applied mutatis mutandis with the necessary replacement of terms under paragraph (13), item (vii)".

AddOn^{(Equity)} in the formula of paragraph (6) shall be calculated as follows. (ii) AddOn(Equity_{k}) in the formula of the preceding item shall be the sum of the amounts obtained by multiplying the effective notional amount of each equity derivative by the supervisory factor specified in the lower column of the following table according to the category of equity derivative listed in its upper column. {{T:p107t0}} (iii) {{F:p107i1}} in the formula of item (i) shall be the value specified in (a) or (b) below according to the category of equity derivative listed in (a) or (b). (a) Equity derivatives referencing a share price: 0.5. (b) Equity derivatives referencing a share price index: 0.8. (iv) The effective notional amount of an equity derivative provided in item (ii) shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the market-value-adjusted notional amount of that equity derivative (meaning the amount obtained by multiplying the number of units of the underlying by the share price or share price index, etc. on the calculation reference date) by the delta adjustment value and the margin period adjustment value. In this case, the term "item (iv)" in item (vii) of that paragraph shall be read as "paragraph (15), item (iii)", the term "interest rate derivative" shall be read as "commodity derivative", the term "paragraph (11), item (vii)(b)" in item (viii) of that paragraph shall be read as "paragraph (11), item (vii)(b) as applied mutatis mutandis with the necessary replacement of terms under paragraph (15), item (v)", and in item (ix) of that paragraph, the term "the preceding paragraph as applied mutatis mutandis with the necessary replacement of terms under paragraph (11), item (viii)" shall be read as "the preceding paragraph as applied mutatis mutandis with the necessary replacement of terms under paragraph (11), item (viii) as applied mutatis mutandis with the necessary replacement of terms under paragraph (15), item (v)", and the term "the items of the preceding paragraph as applied mutatis mutandis with the necessary replacement of terms under paragraph (11), item (viii)" shall be read as "the items of the preceding paragraph as applied mutatis mutandis with the necessary replacement of terms under paragraph (11), item (viii) as applied mutatis mutandis with the necessary replacement of terms under paragraph (15), item (v)".

Notwithstanding the provisions of the proviso to paragraph (1), where a single margin agreement covers multiple netting sets, the credit equivalent amount shall be calculated for each set of those netting sets.

In calculating the credit equivalent amount under the provisions of the preceding paragraph, RC shall be calculated using the following formulas. {{F:p110i0}} C_{MA} = C_{MA，collect} × (1 − Hc_{MA，collect} − Hfx_{MA，collect}) − C_{MA，post} × (1 + Hc_{MA，post} + Hfx_{MA，post}) NS is a netting set (the same applies hereinafter in this paragraph and the following paragraph). MA is a margin agreement (the same applies hereinafter in this paragraph and the following paragraph). V_{NS} is the sum of the market values of the transactions included in NS. C_{MA} is the net collateral amount after haircut adjustment under MA. C_{MA，collect} is the amount of eligible financial collateral received from the counterparty under MA. Hc_{MA，collect} is the haircut applied under MA when receiving eligible financial collateral. Hfx_{MA，collect} is the haircut applied under MA when receiving eligible financial collateral where the currency of the exposure and that of the eligible financial collateral differ. C_{MA，post} is the amount of collateral posted to the counterparty under MA (excluding collateral that is segregated by a third party other than the counterparty and for which the measures necessary to prevent a loss on that collateral in bankruptcy proceedings relating to the counterparty or similar foreign proceedings have been taken). Hc_{MA，post} is the haircut applied under MA, when posting collateral, according to the type of assets delivered to the counterparty. Hfx_{MA，post} is the haircut applied under MA when posting collateral where the currency of the exposure and that of the collateral differ.

In calculating the credit equivalent amount under the provisions of paragraph (16), PFE shall be calculated using the following formula. {{F:p111i0}}{{F:p111i1}} is the amount calculated for the PFE of NS by applying mutatis mutandis the formula for PFE in paragraph (6); provided, however, that it shall be calculated as if no margin agreement had been concluded.
